So, so, small portions of
Jun 2026 • Couples
Good location. Nice to have a vegan restaurant around the corner from the hotel we stayed at for one night.

Food was nice, if not a little bland, but small portions. Came really quickly, although it wasn’t overly busy during our visit. 

Clean restaurant, minimal decor . Staff were more interested in their phones than patrons though, every time you looked at someone who worked there, they were on their phones, even in the kitchen! 

Reasonably priced for a restaurant in Hanoi.

OK ish vegan restaurant
Feb 2026 • Family
Ambiance is nice, though tables to be cleared promptly and to be made ready.
Service is prompt but not attentive. No engagement with the customer ( though not many were there ) to understand if any other items is required or if there is any other requirement or just to proactively elicit the experience thus far.
Food: (visited for lunch on 7th Feb26). Ordered Almond Milk, Cashew Pumpkin Milk, Fried Spring Rolls( oily, not all that great), Brown rice noodles( very small portion). Drinks are OK but not the food per se.
Given the price value proposition, overall experience is underwhelming, specially when there is hardly any other customer at about 3pm on that day.
Washroom is fairly well maintained. But the overall cleanliness need to be improved, as the slippers of the wait staff is strewn around at the stair case...
Both the service levels and the taste of the food to be improved in our humble opinion.

Superb vegan dining and exemplary service
Mar 2024 • Family
We visited Chayfood in Hanoi after reading the reviews on Happy Cow and what a delightful discovery it turned out to be! Our order spanned fresh spring rolls, a spicy Korean rice bowl, pho, and pesto pasta, and each dish exceeded our expectations, leaving us scraping the plates clean. But it wasn't just the exceptional flavours that impressed us; it was the outstanding service that truly stood out. Our waitress went above and beyond, patiently accommodating our customisations – one dish sans mushrooms, another without mock meat, and a third with less spice and garlic – offering helpful suggestions and guidance for nearly 10 minutes, all with a warm and welcoming demeanour. A superb vegan dining experience that left us thoroughly satisfied and eager to return.

Great Vegetarian Food
Jan 2024 • Family
In a city where a lot of the restaurants that call themselves a Vietnamese Food and Vegetarian restaurant, actually have meat dishes and a small vegetarian menu, it was refreshing to find a restaurant that was actually fully vegetarian.

Located in the Old Quarter, the restaurant is small but has 2 floors. In the cool air of January, it was quite nice to sit on the small balcony upstairs and watch the world go by on the street below.

As for the food, there are no words. Everything that we ordered was good, the taste was sublime. The food was so good, we went back again the next day.

If ever we go back to Hanoi, this would be the place we would definitely visit again for the excellent food.
